scope: Unreleased RDP landscape keyboard and chrome fix; installed on the owner's RM2 only
cause: The native input panel stayed portrait while rdpChromeLandscape deliberately switched only the toolbar to portrait. The engine raster stayed landscape, exposing the underlying bitmap header and moving tap targets.
changes: Keep raster, toolbar and shortcuts in the same landscape coordinate space, including during native keyboard dismissal
Find the existing firmware keyboard panel by its explicit virtualkeyboard/window/main view identity and required panel interface
Temporarily rotate and resize the real native panel with reversible QML state changes, without reparenting or replacing firmware resources
Restore original geometry and bindings on hide, foreground loss, close and unexpected RDP window destruction
Bound lazy discovery to 20 attempts at 50 ms; no scene traversal continues during normal typing
Avoid re-entering Qt's global input context from the component destructor; deactivate the borrowed layout state directly instead
Update the connection-screen orientation hint and the physical landscape regression assertion

new_regressions: Native panel geometry and binding restoration on foreground loss and Close
Unexpected window destruction restores the borrowed panel
Only RDP owns landscape rotation; unsupported-panel discovery stops after one second
All shortcuts fit and toolbar positions remain unchanged when hiding the keyboard

physical_tablet.input: Kernel touch events through the existing pt_mt/uinput tablet harness, not direct handler invocation
checks_passed: Landscape keyboard and toolbar visually inspected in captured device frames
Physical native x key entered x in an initially empty remote spreadsheet cell
Native Enter committed the empty cell and moved to the next row; no file was saved
Shortcuts opened with one physical touch while keyboard was visible
Rotated shortcuts and Back remained reachable
Close worked while the native keyboard was visible
Underlying profile editor remained clickable with no orphan X overlay
Profile editing showed the restored portrait system keyboard; Cancel preserved the profile
RDP reconnected and displayed the landscape keyboard again without an intervening interface restart
physical_tablet.intermediate_candidate_note: One earlier candidate encountered SIGSEGV during controlled Xochitl shutdown. Global input-context calls were removed from destruction handling. The final candidate passed ordinary Close, reopen and controlled shutdown; the retained private logs preserve the earlier incident rather than treating it as a passed test.
